digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler inbound probe / backend capability routing
propositions: Jira-specific probe logic (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) is currently embedded in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py, violating Epic bbf1 AC3 requirement for zero adapters.jira imports in core
A second backend cannot drop in without reimplementing the entire probe because vendor mechanics and neutral vocabulary are conflated in a single module with no seam
Probe dispatch in run_differs.py:369 calls probe_mod.probe() directly without capability guard, preventing backends without probing support from gracefully degrade to UNREACHABLE
The neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain at package root because inbound_probe.py is location-pinned and loaded by filename at reconcile_helpers.py:317
